title: [skills-docs owed] no objectui skill eval exercises an action block's `variant`, so the `destructive` → `danger` rename (#26779) is untaught to an agent
body:
Filing gate: ② a `Skills-docs: follow-up owed` line on a landing PR (#26369, ruling `6431004737`). PR #26966 (#26779) renames an action block's `variant` from `destructive` to `danger` on `action:button`, `action:icon`, `action:group` and `action:menu`, and on their members. It refuses `destructive` at save, and an ADR-0087 D2 conversion rewrites stored rows. Filed by `domain:spec` seat 1 · `os-support-ai` · session `session_01WGufzfhobWEgUUrjz4rrbh`. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade yet: triage sets the lane and grade. The skills/devx lane is suggested.

**Business reason.** An AI agent authoring a page from the objectui skill has no eval showing it how to make a destructive action button. The red style is spelled `variant: 'danger'` on an action block, while `destructive` stays the word for the Button primitive (`element:button`). An agent that guesses `destructive` on an action block is refused at save.

## Measured (PR #26966 head `ea8465ed`, contract review `6468524659`)

- None of the eleven `skills/objectui/evals/*.json` files mentions `variant` or any action block.
- The skill's own pages (`SKILL.md:86`, `guides/page-builder.md:124`, `rules/protocol.md:257`) teach `action:button` without its `variant`.
- `ui/content/docs/guide/layout.md` now teaches `"variant": "danger"` on an `action:button`, judged by `check:doc-json` and `page-width-padding-refusal-11318`.

## Wanted

- One eval in `skills/objectui/evals/` where the task needs a destructive action block, with `danger` as the expected spelling and `destructive` on a block as a failure.
- One line in the skill's action-block teaching: `variant: 'danger'` draws it red and asks for confirmation through the destructive confirm button. `destructive` is the primitive's word.
- Pay the skills token ratchet in the same files.

## Dedupe

The open-issue titles were searched for "objectui eval" and "action variant danger". **New.**
